info.title: 21st API
info.description:
REST API for the 21st.dev component marketplace: search and install components, publish components/templates/themes, and manage libraries and your account. This is the same surface the `21st` CLI and the 21st MCP server call — everything here is also reachable through those, but a direct HTTP client (or an agent building its own integration) can call it too.

Most capability is also available with lower friction through the 21st MCP server (https://21st.dev/mcp.md) or the `21st` CLI (https://21st.dev/.well-known/skills/21st-cli-use/SKILL.md) — use this spec when you need direct HTTP access instead.

get.summary: Get the caller's identity, plan, and quota
Get the caller's identity for registry/CLI context (includes team slug)

get.description: Requires a team-scoped API key. `?refresh=1` rotates the token (team owner only).

post.summary: Same as GET — create the invite link if it doesn't exist yet

get.summary: List every library (personal and team) the caller can manage
Get everything needed to install a component
get.description: Files, dependencies, and registry deps for one component — the payload the `21st`/shadcn CLI installs from.

post.summary: Publish a new component, or update an existing one
post.description: Multipart: JSON metadata (see PublishMetadata) alongside the component/demo code and preview media files referenced by index. Spawns a build sandbox; the request is synchronous and returns once the build completes. 30 requests/hour.

429.description: 30 publishes/hour exceeded (`publish_rate_limit_exceeded`), or the general per-key/per-user limit.

patch.summary: Update an owned component's visibility, description, or tags

delete.description: Soft-unpublish: sets visibility to private. Does not hard-delete.

post.summary: Move a component through catalog review

post.description: Metadata-only, no build. Always starts in `draft` status pending moderation.

schema.description: At least one field required. Status/visibility is moderation-only and not settable here.

css.description: Must define both a `:root` and a `.dark` token block.

patch.summary: Rename, retag, or change visibility of an owned theme

get.summary: Get the caller's own bento profile board

post.summary: Upload an image for use in an `image` bento block

dataUrl.description: data: URL, png/jpeg/gif/webp, up to 5MB decoded.

400.description: Bad image / too large (request body cap 8MB).

get.summary: List the caller's published components and in-progress drafts together

parameters.name: component_cursor
parameters.description: Opaque base64url cursor from a previous response.

post.summary: Check out a published component into an editable draft
Create a new draft (spawns a sandbox)
Publish a draft as a real component

get.summary: Get review context for a draft

post.summary: Trigger generated cover/video capture for a draft
Push updated source into an existing draft

ApiKeyAuth.description: A 21st API key, generated at https://21st.dev/mcp. Send as `Authorization: Bearer 21st_sk_...`. Endpoints under Components/Libraries publish-and-manage additionally accept a `21st login`-minted CLI session token in the same header — obtained via the CLI, not something you construct by hand.

slug.description: Present on /registry/me, absent on /me (which has hasGithub instead).

ComponentVisibility.description: `unlisted` and `public` normalize server-side to `published` (`public` additionally submits for catalog featuring).

install_ref.description: Pass to /components/install/{username}/{slug} or the shadcn CLI.

ComponentInstall.description: shadcn registry-item-shaped payload with everything needed to install the component.

file_index.description: Index into the uploaded files for this demo's code.

registry_slug.description: Target library slug. Omit to publish to the default personal library.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, inactive, or expired API key.

RateLimited.description: 100 requests/min per key, 1000/hour per user (tighter on publish and profile-write endpoints, see each operation). `Retry-After` header set.

NotFound.description: No such resource, or it isn't visible to the caller.

tags.name: CLI Studio Drafts
tags.description: Stateful, sandbox-backed draft workflow behind `21st publish`/`21st review`/`21st edit`. Heavier machinery than the rest of the API — most integrations want Components → Publish instead; use this family only if you need incremental edit-review-publish over a single draft.
